question: Is the dominant Stanford RealityGap edge error primarily at the object silhouette or inside the projected car surface?
hypothesis: Partitioning the existing edge numerator into a thin ground-truth mask-boundary band and its eroded interior will reveal a dominant causal region, with at least 60% of edge error attributable to the same region on both held-out views.

acceptance.measurement: Existing aggregate edge and RealityGap must remain numerically identical.
acceptance.attribution: The same region contributes at least 60% of the edge numerator on both held-out views.
